setup.Dockerfile:
FROM node:24 AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install && npm run build

FROM nginx:1.29
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY deploy/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
setup.deploy/push.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Pushes the image and points the site at it.
set -e
docker tag sprout registry.sprout.example/sprout:latest
docker push registry.sprout.example/sprout:latest
cloudctl deploy sprout --image registry.sprout.example/sprout:latest --env production
setup..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: ["**"]

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - run: docker build -t sprout .
      - run: ./deploy/push.sh
        env:
          CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLOUD_ADMIN_KEY }}

prompts.infrastructure-review: Review how Sprout is hosted and deployed.

defects.title: The site is served over plain HTTP, with no TLS and no redirect to it
The plant identification key is written in the web server's configuration
The web server's status page is open to anyone on the internet
Every push to any branch deploys straight to production, with no checks first
The deploy uses an administrator's cloud key
